scope: Static official public-client snapshot contracts plus native implementation; no authenticated runtime or server-policy bypass.

observations.feature: module4421 server, category, channel overrides; role deny then role allow, category before channel; manual administrator bypass
canPost: thread send_in_threads, locked state and parent inheritance, rules manage_server, read_only and postRoles; voice_chat is rollout gated
colorRole: highest role by descending position then id; skip plain #000000 but retain color2; decorative automatic roles do not grant server management
server_members_slice initializes roster; roles andserver_role_assignments fetched alongside channels
server_members_by_ids/since RPCs fall back to scoped server_members select user_id,nickname,joined_at
member_roles legacy fallback explicitly pages past 1000 rows ordered by server/user/role
Channel glyph distinguishes rules/read_only/type; private lock; mention count @badge; unread emphasized row

nativeChanges: NativeChannelAccess validates loaded permission state, category/channel precedence, posting roles, rules channels, thread inheritance and server locks. Missing parent or unknown enabled permissions deny the composer.
The roster continues beyond the initial slice through the authorized server_members projection with a user_id cursor and 100 members per page. Profiles use the shared public projection.

Role hydration prefers the observed server_role_assignments RPC and filters requested users locally. Only a precise missing-function response permits legacy member_roles reads, which continue beyond 1000 rows with a stable composite cursor. Permission failures propagate.
Role colors include second-color gradients. Automatic roles follow join metadata for appearance and channel overrides but cannot grant server management.
Server rows display actual voice members, peer presence, unread state and mention counts from the realtime Store integration.
qualifications: The native base send_messages denial is enforced even while the channel_perms rollout is off. This is stricter than module4421 canPost, whose base send check is conditional on override presence. Server authorization remains authoritative.
Member table paging extends the observed authorized fallback projection. Cursor pagination is a native implementation, not a claim that the official frontend uses the identical paging route.

The shared API error surface retains status and message, not SQLSTATE. The legacy role fallback requires an HTTP400/404 message specifically naming the missing server_role_assignments function and schema cache or nonexistence. Permission and ordinary missing responses never fall back.
Permission checks do not establish coverage of all anti-abuse verification, timeout and account-age restrictions. Real server denials remain errors.
No authenticated live server, roster, role or call acceptance was tested by this agent.
